author: toketrain
body:
Today I had an idea. I'm certain that I am not the first to have this idea of course, but I would like to share anyways.

My idea is that each gamemode have a lobby of its own. These lobbies would have kits, like this:


The kits names would be displayed, along with the level to get them at, like so:





These lobbies could also have parkour with possible rewards, and other games to keep bored players in the games when waiting.


Also, if enough players have joined a lobby, they can vote for which map to play on. This has been done by servers before, so it's not original, but it's a great idea and would also help staff discover which maps are most liked without the troll responses. 

Thanks :p
